description: Create a green/pink RELATIVE vision image from the MOST RECENT screenshot, for commands like "BClickRelative | Target: <name>.png". The green box marks the anchor element that is searched on the page; the pink box marks where to click, relative to the anchor. Coordinates are absolute pixels in the last screenshot.

name.description: Base name for the image file (letters, digits, underscore)

why.description: One short sentence shown in the Ui.Vision log: what this call does and why.

name: save_relative_image
